processors.description: Which Cohesity protection group backs up this host, keyed on the host's own Smartscape id. Ships EMPTY so the pipeline is inert until the sync workflow populates it; no defaultValue, so a host with no Cohesity backup is left completely untouched. See README 'Linking protection groups to hosts'.

The Cohesity cluster id for the same host. A second lookup because the protection group's node id is built from TWO components and the extension emits them separately: the raw cluster id, and the group id already namespaced as {clusterId}_{groupId}. One table cannot carry both values for one key.

Computes the id of the protection group entity the extension's own metrics already create, WITHOUT creating a second one - extractNode is false. The idComponents and their order mirror cohesity-protection-group-node exactly; a different name or order yields a different id, which resolves to an empty duplicate entity rather than failing.

The edge ticket 16 exists for: a backup job, joined to the infrastructure Dynatrace already monitors. Source is the protection group because 'protects' reads with the actor first, and because custom-source to built-in-target is the direction proven to validate server-side. The HOST is resolved, never minted - Dynatrace owns it.
